title: Signing in
caption: Organisation, username and password, then Sign in.

title: The workspace
caption: Every screen this account may use, grouped by area. What it may not use is not shown at all.

title: A second factor, when an action asks for one
caption: Some actions ask for a six-digit code: from an authenticator app, or python examples/evaluate/totp.py.

title: Subjects: everyone the tenant holds
caption: Reference, org unit, classification and labels, for every person and organisation.

title: One subject, opened
caption: The record and the actions this account may take on it, decided by the server for this row.

title: Customers: the 360° overview
caption: Type the start of a name (Subject 000): lines, balance and open cases on one row.

title: Knowledge: collections of documents
caption: What the assistant may consult. Sensitivity decides what may ever reach an outside model.

title: The agent, before a grant
caption: Signed in as the care agent: the answer comes only from the handbook labelled for staff.

title: Granting one person one collection
caption: Collection, person and capability by name; a reference and a reason, which the audit keeps.

title: Who may reach it
caption: The grant is listed on the collection and holds until revoked.

title: The agent, after the grant
caption: The same question: the answer now comes from the network operations runbooks.

title: Asking the assistant
caption: Passages ranked, each with its document, revision, collection and sensitivity.

title: Configuring an AI provider
caption: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, by its full URL. The key is sealed and never shown again.

title: Encryption keys
caption: Which key generation seals each kind of personal data, counted without opening any.

title: Integrations (webhooks)
caption: Register an endpoint, choose the facts, send a test ping, and see every attempt.

title: The audit trail
caption: Every change, hash-chained; the grant just made is at the top.

title: Revoking access
caption: The grant ends at once and stays on the record beside its revocation.

title: Your sessions and password
caption: Where this account is signed in. On the published accounts, the installation manages the password.
